column1: # Liquid end members of the MELTS liquid (Ghiorso and Sack 1995, Table A1 and appendix), numbers as
# used in ThermoEngine v2 (gitlab.com/ENKI-portal/ThermoEngine, src/LiquidMelts.m, AGPL-3), taken
# with Douglas's approval on 2026-11-01 because they correct several values that are hard to read in
# the scanned paper.  Reference solid: H (J), S (J/K), Berman Cp k0..k3, lambda l1, l2 with a
# first-order step deltaH (J) at Tt (K); liquid volume terms at 1673.15 K and 1 bar; fusion T (K),
# dS (J/K) and liquid Cp (J/K).  Na2SiO3 H and S are in cal in the source (x 4.184 applied).
# Hematite differs from Berman (1988): H = -822000 J, S = 87.40 J/K (GS1995 Table A1).
# SiO2 (amorphous, Richet et al. 1982) and H2O have their own expressions; see standard_state.py.
